thread:
Aria Novak: Heads-up: publishing the community-plugin-registry v1.0.0 right now. This bundles vetted plugin adapters, a security checklist for maintainers, and a lightweight CLI for local testing. Release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugin-registry/releases/tag/v1.0.0 :rocket:
DevOps Bot: Release job started for plugin-registry v1.0.0
Hector Ruiz: Huge milestone, congrats team! Quick Q: does the security checklist include the third-party license audit step?
Lena Becker: Yes  added license-audit.md and an automated SPDX check in CI. See CONTRIBUTING.md for steps.
open-source-bot: Release published: plugin-registry v1.0.0  artifacts: registry-v1.0.0.tar.gz, cli-linux.zip, security-checklist.md
Aria Novak: Thanks all. Action items: (1) maintainers, please run `prisma up` on your plugin sandbox and report issues, (2) volunteers: we need two reviewers for the security checklist by EOD.
Hector Ruiz: I'll take reviewer slot 1. Running sandbox now and will paste logs if anything breaks.
Lena Becker: I'll be reviewer 2. Also drafting a community post with migration tips for plugin authors.
DevOps Bot: CI: build SUCCESS, spdx-scan SUCCESS, smoke-tests SUCCESS
Aria Novak: Perfect. We'll host a brief walkthrough tomorrow 15:00 UTC (15 minutes) to demo the CLI and explain the checklist. Calendar invite to follow.
Hector Ruiz: Sandbox smoke test passed locally. Small lint fix pushed to patch branch.
Lena Becker: Draft blog post ready at /marketing/drafts/plugin-registry-v1.md. Will loop in comms for publish timing.
Aria Novak: Closing this announcement thread. Follow-ups will continue in #community-plugins and #eng-security. Thanks everyone :tada:
